name: Hollow Rider
lore: An empty suit of armour carries a pumpkin lantern through Moonveil’s midnight roads. His spectral mare remembers every traveller he has guided home.

primary.name: Spectral Scythe
primary.description: Tap for a 25-damage scythe sweep, or hold up to 1.3s for 45 damage. Full charge inflicts bleed for 2 damage/s for 3s.
primary.ui_brief: Charged scythe • 25–45 damage • full charge bleeds

secondary.name: Lantern Toll
secondary.description: Raise the lantern for 0.3 seconds, then slam a spectral shockwave: 26 damage, knockback and 1.2-second stun within 125 reach.

special.name: Midnight Gallop
special.description: Ride a spectral horse for 5s: +30% speed, +6 primary damage, and 5 hoof damage every 0.75s to nearby foes. No invulnerability.

passive: Lantern Courage: hitting an enemy with Lantern Toll grants 12% damage reduction for 2 seconds.

technique.name: Broad Reaping
technique.description: A wider sweep trades damage and attack speed for coverage.

attack.name: Broad Reaping
attack.description: A wider 115-reach sweep: 19 damage on tap, up to 34.2 charged; full charge bleeds for 2 damage/s for 3s. 0.95s cooldown.

final_technique.name: Last Watch
final_technique.description: Trade mounted mobility for a targetable stationary guardian.

attack.name: Last Watch
attack.description: A spectral horse guards the spot ahead for 6s: 70 health, 14 melee damage, 120 reach. It can be attacked and killed.
